DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。友人が犬を連れて来ます。ここに立つとベンチへ行く人の道をふさいでしまいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 犬連れの友人待ちで通路をふさいでいると説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. My friend is bringing a dog. Standing here blocks the way for people going to the bench.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that waiting for a friend with a dog is blocking the passage. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 少し横に広い場所があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: There is a wider area a little to the side.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: そちらで待ちます。犬が苦手な人も通れるよう、道の中央には集まらないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 広い脇の場所へ移り通路を空ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: I will wait there. We will not gather in the middle, so people uncomfortable around dogs can pass too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Move to the wide area at the side and leave the path clear. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 友人へ場所を知らせられますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Can you tell your friend where you are?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 今、案内板の左側へ変えると送ります。元のベンチに来たら、ここで呼ばずメッセージで伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 新目印を友人へ文字で知らせる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will message now that we are moving to the left of the signboard. If they come to the original bench, I will message rather than call out here.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Tell your friend the new landmark in writing. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ご自身も犬を連れているのですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Do you have a dog with you too?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: いいえ。犬を連れるのは友人だけです。近くにいる別の犬の飼い主と間違えないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 犬の飼主は友人だけと明確にする。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: No. Only my friend has a dog. Please do not confuse me with the owner of another dog nearby.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Clarify that only your friend is the dog's owner. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 合流後は園内を歩きますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Will you walk in the park after meeting?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。友人と表示を確認してから歩きます。待ち合わせの場所が空いていても、犬の利用範囲を決めつけません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 合流後に利用範囲の表示を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. We will check the signs together before walking. An empty meeting spot does not tell us where dogs are permitted.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Check signs about permitted areas after meeting. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 案内板の横でお待ちください。合流後は園内の表示をご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please wait beside the signboard. Check the park signs after meeting.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 定期券についてのご相談ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you asking about your commuter pass?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 来週から勤務場所が変わります。でも今の定期券は月末まで残っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 勤務先変更と定期残期間を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: My workplace changes next week, but my current pass is valid until the end of the month.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Discuss the workplace change and remaining pass period. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 新しい行き先は今の区間に入っていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Is the new destination within your current route?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 入りません。残りの日数があるから、新しい駅にもそのまま行けるとは思っていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 新区間が現定期外と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: No. I do not assume I can travel to the new station just because days remain on the pass.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that the new route is outside the current pass. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 現在の券と新しい経路を確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let us check your current pass and the new route.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: こちらです。会社の通勤先変更日は月曜です。今日から券を変える必要があるかも聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 切替開始日と経路を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: Here they are. My workplace changes on Monday. I also want to ask whether I must change the pass starting today.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Give the switch date and route. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 変更や残り期間の扱いは担当が確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: The staff will check changes and how the remaining period is handled.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: お願いします。会社への交通費の報告もあるので、今の券の控えは残しておきたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 会社への費用報告用に現券控えを残したいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: Please do. I need to report commuting expenses to my employer, so I want to retain a record of the current pass.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you want to keep a pass record for reporting expenses. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 新しい券を買う前に必要な手続きを聞いてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Ask about the necessary procedures before buying a new pass.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。切替日と現在の券の扱いを確認し、会社へも実際に済んだ内容を伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 券扱いと切替日確認後に実施内容を会社へ伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I will confirm the switch date and handling of the current pass, then tell my employer what was actually completed.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm pass handling and switch date, then report completed actions to your employer. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 券と経路の資料を担当へお見せください。月曜からの利用と残り期間を分けてご相談ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Show the staff the pass and route information. Discuss use from Monday separately from the remaining period.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 住所の記入でお困りですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you having trouble entering your address?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 建物名が長く、この欄に収まりません。勝手に短く書いてよいか聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 建物名が欄に収まらず省略可否を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: The building name is long and does not fit. I want to ask whether I may shorten it myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether a building name too long for the field can be abbreviated. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 部屋番号は分かっていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do you know the room number?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい、三〇二です。建物名と部屋番号を一緒に削るつもりはありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 部屋番号を示し一緒に省略しないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes, three zero two. I am not planning to omit the building name and room number together.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Give the room number and explain you will not omit both together. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 続きの記入方法を担当へ確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: I will ask the staff how to continue the entry.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。郵便の宛名では略したことがありますが、届出でも同じでよいとは考えていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 郵便表記と届出表記を区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please do. I have abbreviated it on mail before, but I do not assume the same is allowed on an official notification.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Distinguish postal address wording from official notification wording. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 契約書など住所が分かる資料はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Do you have a contract or other document showing the address?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: この契約書です。建物名の正式な表記はこちらにあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 正式住所の契約書を提示する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: This contract. The building's official name is written here.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Show the contract with the official address. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その表記を見て、記入方法を案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will use that wording to explain how to enter it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。欄に合うように直す場合も、変更した箇所を自分で確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 変更箇所を確認して記入すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. Even if it is adjusted to fit the field, I will check the changed parts myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will check any changed parts when entering it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 資料をお見せください。部屋番号を含めた住所の記入を担当と確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Show us the document. Let us confirm with the staff how to enter the address including the room number.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 検査が終わった方ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: You have finished your test, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。採血は終わりましたが、結果を聞く日の予約はまだ取っていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 採血終了と結果説明予約未取得を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. The blood draw is finished, but I have not booked the appointment to hear the results.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain the blood draw is done but the results appointment is not booked. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 診察で次の受診の案内はありましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Were you told about the next visit during the consultation?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 一週間後に結果を聞くと言われました。曜日の話だけで、予約時刻が確定したとは思っていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 一週間後の案内と予約時刻確定を区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: I was told to hear the results in a week. A discussion of the day does not mean an appointment time was confirmed.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Distinguish guidance for one week later from a confirmed appointment time. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 予約の窓口へ案内できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: I can direct you to the booking desk.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。会計を終えて帰る前に、次の予約が必要か確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 会計退出前に予約要否を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please do. Before paying and leaving, I want to check whether another appointment is needed.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Check whether booking is necessary before paying and leaving. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 来られる時間はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Are there times when you can come?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 午前は仕事です。午後の空きがあるか相談し、希望時刻と予約済みの時刻を分けて会社へ伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 勤務時間に合う午後希望と確定予約を別連絡する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I work in the morning. I will ask about afternoon availability and tell my employer my preferred time separately from the booked time.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Separate an afternoon preference fitting work from a confirmed booking when reporting. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 予約票を受け取ったら、日付をご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: When you receive the appointment slip, check the date.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。結果が出る予定と説明を受ける予約を区別し、予約票の日時を確認してから帰ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 結果予定と説明予約を分け予約票日時を照合する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I will distinguish when results are expected from the appointment to hear them, and check the slip's date and time before leaving.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Separate expected results and the explanation appointment, then check the slip. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 予約相談の窓口はこちらです。検査済みで、結果説明の予約が未確定とお伝えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: The booking consultation desk is here. Tell them the test is finished and the results appointment is not confirmed.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 今日はどのようなご相談ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: What would you like to discuss today?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 昨夜、建物の外で大きい音がして心配でした。私が見た範囲を説明したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 夜の音と自身の観察を説明したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: I was worried by a loud noise outside the building last night. I want to explain what I observed myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you want to explain the nighttime noise and your own observations. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: どのくらい続きましたか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 十一時頃に二回聞きました。外を見ましたが、誰が出した音かは分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 時刻回数と発生者不明を答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: I heard it twice around eleven. I looked outside, but I do not know who made the noise.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Give the time and number of sounds, and explain the source is unknown. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 人が争っている様子は見えましたか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 見ていません。近所の人はけんかと言っていますが、私はその場面を確認していません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 他人の噂と自分の未確認を区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: No. Neighbors say it was a fight, but I did not confirm that scene myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Distinguish others' rumors from what you have not confirmed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 場所を地図で示せますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Can you show the location on a map?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: この建物の裏側です。自分の部屋から聞こえた位置なので、正確な発生場所とは限りません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 聞こえた方向と正確な発生点不明を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: Behind this building. That is the direction heard from my room, not necessarily the exact source.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Give the direction heard and explain the exact source is unknown. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今は聞こえません。再び起きた時の連絡方法と、伝える情報を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 現在は止まり再発時の連絡情報を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I cannot hear it now. Please explain how to contact you and what information to give if it happens again.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Explain it has stopped and ask about reporting if it recurs. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 聞いた時刻と見えた範囲を記録します。現在の状態に合わせた相談先を担当からご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: We will record when you heard it and what you could see. The staff will explain a contact suitable for the current situation.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。不在票は家族の名前ですが、私の在留カードだけで受け取れるか確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 家族宛荷物と本人資料での受取可否を質問する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. The missed-delivery notice is in a family member's name. I want to check whether I can collect it with only my residence card.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about collecting a family member's parcel with your own documents. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 宛名とご本人のお名前は別ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: The addressee's name differs from yours, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。同じ家に住んでいますが、名前は違います。本人宛てとして渡してほしいという意味ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 同居だが宛名と本人名が別と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. We live together, but our names differ. I am not asking you to hand it over as though it were addressed to me.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain you live together but your name differs from the addressee. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 受取に必要な確認を担当へ聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: I will ask the staff what verification is needed.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。足りない資料があれば、家族と準備してから来ます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 不足資料を家族と準備すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please do. If documents are missing, I will prepare them with my family and come back.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will prepare missing documents with your family. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 不在票の住所は現在の住所で合っていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Does the address on the notice match your current address?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 合っています。宛名の家族も現在そこに住んでいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 宛先住所と家族居住を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. The family member named there also currently lives there.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm the delivery address and the family member's residence. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 票とお持ちの資料を確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Let us check the notice and documents you brought.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: こちらです。受け取れる条件が確認できるまでは、荷物を渡された扱いにしないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 条件確認前に受取完了としないよう依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: Here they are. Please do not mark the parcel as received until the collection conditions are confirmed.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ask not to mark receipt complete before conditions are confirmed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 宛名と同居の確認について担当へつなぎます。必要な資料を先にご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will connect you to the staff for addressee and cohabitation checks. We will first explain the documents needed.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 通帳の内容についてでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is this about the bankbook entries?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 昨日ATMで入金したつもりですが、残高が変わっていません。記帳だけだったかもしれません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 入金か記帳か曖昧で残高不変と相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: I thought I deposited cash at the ATM yesterday, but the balance has not changed. Perhaps I only updated the bankbook.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Discuss an unchanged balance and uncertainty between depositing and updating the book. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 現金は機械へ入れましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Did you put cash into the machine?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 財布からは出しましたが、入れた記憶が曖昧です。現金は今も財布にあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 現金投入記憶と手元現金を正直に説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: I took it out of my wallet, but I do not clearly remember inserting it. The cash is still in my wallet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Honestly explain the unclear memory of inserting cash and cash still in hand. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 操作の時刻と控えを確認できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Can you check the time and transaction receipt?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 午後六時頃です。控えはなく、通帳の更新部分だけあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 時刻と更新通帳のみを提示する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: Around six in the evening. I have no receipt, only the updated bankbook section.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Give the time and show only the updated bankbook. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 担当が確認できる操作記録について案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: The staff will explain what transaction records can be checked.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: お願いします。残高が変わらないだけで、機械に取られたと決めつけたくありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 機械による損失と断定しないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: Please do. I do not want to conclude the machine took my money just because the balance did not change.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you are not concluding that the machine caused a loss. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 今日はこの現金を入金する予定ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Do you plan to deposit this cash today?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 先に昨日の操作を確認します。現金の枚数も数え直し、必要なら今日の入金として別に頼みます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 昨日の確認と今日の入金を別手続きにする。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will check yesterday's actions first. I will recount the notes too and, if needed, request a separate deposit for today.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Separate checking yesterday from making today's deposit. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 昨日の操作の相談と、今日の入金を分けて担当へご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: We will guide you to the staff with yesterday's inquiry separate from today's deposit.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you asking about the price label?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この二百円は一個の値段ですか。二個セットと小さく書いてあるようです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 二百円表示が単品かセットか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: Is this two hundred yen for one item? It seems to say a set of two in small print.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether the two-hundred-yen price is for one or a set. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらは二個まとめた時の表示です。一個だけをご希望ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: That is the price for two together. Do you want just one?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。一人暮らしなので、一個だけ欲しいです。一個でも半分の値段になるかは分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 単品希望と単純半額の未確認を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. I live alone and only want one. I do not know whether one would simply be half the price.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain you want one and half-price has not been confirmed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 単品の値段は、こちらの欄です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: The single-item price is in this section.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 分かりました。二個買った方が単価は低いですが、使い切れないので単品にします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 使い切れる量を優先して単品を選ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: Understood. Buying two is cheaper per item, but I cannot use both up, so I will choose one.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Prioritize the amount you can use and choose a single item. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 同じ種類を一個でよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: One of the same type is fine?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。別の種類を混ぜた二個でも同じ条件かは、今回は試しません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 種類混合の条件を推測せず同種一個を指定する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. I will not try assuming the same conditions apply to two mixed types this time.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Specify one of the same type without guessing mixed-type conditions. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: こちら一個をお持ちください。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。単品の表示額で買うことを確認して会計します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 単品額と数量を会計で確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. I will confirm it is bought at the displayed single-item price before paying.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Check the single-item price and quantity at checkout. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 単品一個ですね。会計でも種類と数量をご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: One single item, correct. Check the type and quantity at checkout too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 子どもの工作に使う落ち葉を、少し持ち帰ってよいか聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 工作用途の落葉持帰り可否を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I want to ask whether I may take a few fallen leaves home for my child's craft project.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether fallen leaves may be taken home for crafts. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 木に付いている葉を取る予定ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Are you planning to pick leaves attached to a tree?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: いいえ。地面に落ちているものだけです。枝を折ったり、花壇へ入ったりしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 落ちた葉のみで植栽を傷つけないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: No, only leaves on the ground. I will not break branches or enter the flower beds.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain only fallen leaves and no damage to plants. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 持帰りの扱いを管理担当へ確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let us check the rules for taking them home with management.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。掃除で集めた山の葉も自由に持ってよいとは、決めていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 清掃済みの葉も自由と決めないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please do. I am not assuming that leaves collected in a cleanup pile can freely be taken either.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you are not assuming cleaned-up leaves are free to take. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: どのくらい必要ですか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 十枚くらいです。通路で拾うなら、人が来たら先に通れるよう横に寄ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 必要枚数と通行優先を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: About ten. If I pick them up on the path, I will move aside for people to pass first.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Give the number needed and prioritize passage. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 小さい袋があります。許可を聞くまでは拾い始めず、使わない葉を園内へ散らかさないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 袋持参と回答前の採取を保留する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: A small bag. I will not start picking before hearing permission, and I will avoid scattering unused leaves around the park.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Explain you brought a bag and will wait for an answer before collecting. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 担当へ用途と量を伝えます。回答が出るまで、通路脇でお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15206-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: We will tell management the purpose and amount. Wait beside the path until an answer comes.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 待合室のコンセントに充電器を残したかもしれません。列車はまだ乗っていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 乗車前に待合室へ充電器を残したと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: I may have left my charger in the waiting room socket. I have not boarded a train yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain before boarding that your charger may be in the waiting room. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ご自身で置いた場所を覚えていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do you remember where you placed it yourself?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 窓側の席です。充電器は白く、ケーブルに小さい赤い印があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 席と充電器ケーブルの特徴を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: A window-side seat. The charger is white and the cable has a small red mark.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Describe the seat, charger and cable features. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 発車まで時間はありますか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 五分です。急いで走って取りに戻るより、係の方に場所を確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 発車まで五分で係へ確認を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: Five minutes. Rather than rushing back at a run, I want the staff to check the location.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain five minutes remain and ask the staff to check. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 駅で保管しているか確認できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: We can check whether the station is holding it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: お願いします。車内の忘れ物ではなく、待合室に置いた物として調べてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 車内忘れ物と区別して検索を依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: Please do. Search as an item left in the waiting room, not on a train.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Request a search distinguishing it from an onboard lost item. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 発車に間に合わなければ、どうされますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: What will you do if you cannot make departure?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 荷物の確認を優先して次の列車にします。まだ乗っていない列車の中を探す必要はありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 未乗車の列車でなく駅内確認を優先する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will prioritize checking my belongings and take the next train. There is no need to search a train I have not boarded.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Prioritize checking inside the station rather than an unboarded train. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 待合室の窓側を確認します。こちらでお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: We will check the window side of the waiting room. Please wait here.
